title: People list loads with stat tiles
steps: Click 'People' in the left sidebar.
Wait for the page to finish loading (grey shimmer boxes disappear).
Look at the four tiles at the top: Total People, Active, Onboarding, Departments.
expected: Tiles show real numbers (no shimmer stuck). The employee list appears below with photo, name, code, title and a coloured status chip on every row.

title: Search finds a person by name, email, code or job title
steps: On the People tab, click into the search box ('Search people…').
Type the first few letters of someone's name.
Note the 'X total · Y active · Z shown' counter next to the filters.
Clear the search with the X in the box.
expected: The list narrows as you type; the 'shown' number matches the rows on screen; clearing the search brings everyone back.

title: Company filter narrows the list and resets the department filter
precondition: Employees exist in at least two companies
steps: Open the company dropdown (says 'All companies') and pick one company.
Check who is listed now.
Open the department dropdown next to it.
Pick a department, then switch the company dropdown to a different company.
expected: Only that company's people are listed. The department dropdown only offers departments actually used in that company. Switching company resets the department filter back to 'All departments'.

title: Create an employee with just a first name
steps: Click 'Add Employee' (top right).
Type only a first name (e.g. 'Testy').
Leave every other field empty.
Click Save.
expected: The employee is created and selected in the list. No error. An employee code (GG-###) is auto-assigned.

title: Department stays locked until you choose a company
precondition: At least one company with departments exists (Company setup)
steps: Click 'Add Employee'.
WITHOUT choosing a company, click the Department dropdown.
expected: The department dropdown is disabled and reads '— pick a company first —'. It only becomes usable after a company is selected, and then lists only that company's departments.

title: KNOWN ISSUE — changing company keeps the old department
precondition: Employee saved with Company A + a department
steps: Edit that employee.
Change the Company dropdown to Company B.
Look at the Department field.
expected: EXPECTED (correct behaviour): department should clear because it belongs to Company A. CURRENT BUG: the old department stays as '(current)' and can be saved against the wrong company. Log result either way.

title: Contractor fields appear only for contractors
steps: In the employee form, set Employment type = Contractor.
Scroll down.
Now switch Employment type back to Full time.
expected: A 'Contractor engagement' section (scope, SOW, client, dates, rate…) appears when Contractor is chosen and disappears again when switched back.

title: Emails are accepted without checking (log as found)
steps: Type 'not-an-email' into Work email.
Click Save.
expected: BUG CHECK: today this saves without complaint (no email format validation). Note whether garbage emails are accepted.

title: Assign a job role while creating (admin only)
precondition: Admin; at least one job role exists
steps: Click 'Add Employee' as an administrator.
Fill first name AND a work email.
In the 'Job role & access' box, pick a role.
Save.
expected: Toast confirms the person was added AND the job role/access assigned. (If work email was blank, a different toast says to set the role later on the Access tab.)

title: Tabs show/hide by permission
precondition: One admin account, one non-admin, one without hr_comp grant
steps: Open any employee's card as an ADMIN — note the tabs.
Repeat as a user WITHOUT the compensation grant.
Repeat as a non-admin.
expected: Admin sees Overview / Pay & Benefits / Compliance / Assets / Documents / Access. Without hr_comp the 'Pay & Benefits' tab is missing. Non-admin never sees the 'Access' tab.

title: External/guest badge shows on the card
precondition: An employee saved with Account type = External or Guest
steps: Open that person's card.
Look next to their name in the header.
expected: An orange 'External' (or 'Guest') badge appears beside the name. Internal people have no badge.

title: Set someone inactive with mailbox delegation
steps: Open the employee card and click the status chip (e.g. 'Active').
Choose status 'Inactive', type a reason.
In the mailbox section pick a colleague to delegate to.
Click Apply.
expected: Status changes with a toast; a PowerShell snippet + admin links are offered for the mailbox step; the change appears in the recent-changes log with the reason.

title: CAUTION — offboarding warns about everything it will do
precondition: TEST DATA ONLY — never a real employee
steps: Open a TEST employee's card, click the status chip.
Choose 'Left' (offboarded).
Read the options: remove & free licence vs shared mailbox, export-mailbox tick, equipment warning.
Click Apply ONCE and watch carefully.
expected: BUG CHECK: Apply currently runs sign-in block + licence removal + force-return of all equipment with NO extra confirmation. Verify what happens and log it — we want a confirm step here.

title: Add a company and its departments
steps: On the People tab click 'Company setup'.
Click 'Add Company', give it a name (e.g. 'QA Test Co'), Save.
Back on the list, click 'Departments' on that company.
Type 'Estimating' and click Add. Add it AGAIN in lowercase ('estimating').
Remove one department with its X.
expected: Company is created. 'Estimating' is added once — the duplicate is ignored (case-insensitive). Removing a department leaves existing employees' records untouched (note under the list says so).

title: Greens Global comes pre-seeded; new companies start empty
steps: Open Company setup > Greens (Global) > Departments.
Now open Departments on any other company you just created.
expected: Greens shows the 9 standard departments including 'Administration' (NOT 'Admin'). The new company's list is empty.

title: Expand, search and spotlight a division
steps: Open the 'Org Chart' tab.
Click a person's reports pill (the number under them) to collapse/expand their team.
Type a name in the search box.
Click one of the coloured division names in the legend.
expected: Teams collapse/expand. Search centres the chart on the match. Clicking a division dims everyone else (spotlight).

title: Drag a person to a new manager; loops are rejected
precondition: Desktop; at least 3 people in a chain
steps: In the org chart, press and hold a person's card and drag it onto a DIFFERENT manager card.
Now try to drag a MANAGER onto one of their own reports.
expected: First drag: person's reporting line changes (confirm in their card). Second drag: rejected with a toast (no loops allowed).

title: Move a candidate through the pipeline to Hired
steps: Click 'Add Candidate', enter a first name and role, Save.
Open the candidate and use the stage buttons to move Applied → Screening → Interview → Offer.
Click 'Mark Hired'.
expected: Candidate moves across the kanban lanes with a history entry per move. On Hired, an employee record is auto-created with status 'Onboarding' (check the People tab).

title: Resume upload and interview scheduling give feedback
steps: Open a candidate, upload a resume PDF.
Schedule an interview for tomorrow.
Now try uploading a corrupt/huge file, or disconnect Wi-Fi and retry.
expected: Happy path: resume appears, interview shows. BUG CHECK: failures are currently SILENT (no error toast) — log whether you get any feedback when it fails.

title: Log leave on behalf and approve it
steps: Click 'Log leave', pick an employee, type Vacation, 2 days, tomorrow → day after, Save.
Find the pending request and click Approve.
Look at the 'Who's out' week strip.
expected: Request is created as pending, then approved. The person appears on the week strip on those days with approved styling.

title: BUG CHECK — end date before start date is accepted
steps: Create a leave request with From = Friday and To = Monday BEFORE it.
Save.
expected: EXPECTED: a validation error. CURRENT: it saves without complaint. Log result.

title: Sync from M365 reports what changed
steps: On the People tab click 'Sync from M365'.
Wait for the toast.
expected: Toast summarises created/linked/updated/removed. CAUTION: sync can REMOVE employees without asking — verify the numbers look sane before/after.

title: Matrix, duplicate a role, expand a group
steps: Open the 'Roles & Access' tab (admins only).
Matrix: check each pill sits under a module column header.
Job roles: select a role, click 'Duplicate' — the editor opens pre-filled with the name auto-numbered (e.g. 'HR Administrator 2'). Save.
Groups: click a group's member count.
expected: Duplicate creates a NEW role (original untouched). Group member count expands to a list of NAMES (never raw emails) with a remove X per person.

title: My HR loads my own record only
precondition: Signed in as an employee with an HR record
steps: Click 'My HR' in the sidebar.
Check the four tiles: hours, leave this year, documents, tenure.
Check the profile card shows YOUR name/job/department.
expected: Everything on screen is about you — no other employees visible anywhere.

title: I can edit only contact + emergency details
steps: Click Edit on the profile card.
Change your phone and personal email; add an emergency contact.
Save.
Confirm name / job title / bank fields are NOT editable here.
expected: Contact + emergency save with confirmation. Everything else is read-only ('goes through Ask HR').

title: My documents and paystubs list and search
precondition: At least one sealed document / paystub exists for you
steps: Scroll to 'My documents'. If more than 3, use the search box.
Click one to open it.
Repeat for 'My paystubs'.
expected: Only your documents appear; search filters; clicking opens the PDF.

title: Request time off
steps: Find 'My leave' and click 'Request time off'.
Pick a type, tomorrow → day after, add a note, Send.
Check the request list.
expected: Request appears as Pending. (BUG CHECK: try end-before-start too — it currently saves; log it.)

title: BUG CHECK — no way to cancel a pending request
precondition: You have a pending time-off request
steps: Look at your pending request in the list.
Try to find any cancel/withdraw button.
expected: CURRENT GAP: there is no cancel option — a mistaken request can only be rejected by a manager. Log as UX gap.

title: Send a request to HR with an attachment
steps: In 'Ask HR', pick a type, describe the request, attach a small file.
Send.
Check your request history below.
expected: Request appears in your history as open. HR sees it in their Employee Requests panel on the People tab.

title: My hours chart follows the range picker
steps: In 'My hours', switch the range (7/14/30 days).
expected: Bars update to the chosen window; the hours tile matches.

title: BUG CHECK — failed loads look like empty data
precondition: Dev tools: block/fail the documents API (or test offline)
steps: Open My HR with the documents request failing (or airplane-mode after login).
Look at the 'My documents' section.
expected: CURRENT BUG: a failed load shows 'No documents yet' — identical to genuinely having none. Log it (should show a retry/error).

title: Home cards route correctly
steps: Open Item Management.
Click 'Checkout an Item' → should land on Catalog. Go back.
Click 'Extend an Item' → lands on My Checkouts.
Managers only: check the 'Manage Items' card appears.
expected: Each card routes to the right tab. (Note: the 'Extend an Item' card actually covers return AND extend — title is misleading; log as minor.)

title: Browse, filter and understand availability
steps: Open Catalog. Type a name in search; try the type and location chips.
Find an item that is checked out by someone.
expected: Filters narrow the grid. Unavailable items show who has them and 'available in N d' instead of the Add button.

title: Build a cart and submit a request
steps: Add two items to the cart.
Open the cart. Set days on the first item, click 'Apply first to all'.
Pick an approver (required) and type a reason (required).
Submit.
expected: Cart requires approver + reason before submitting. On success you land on Active Checkouts with the new pending order and a toast.

title: Days are capped at 90
steps: In the cart try to set 91+ days with the stepper or by typing.
expected: The value clamps to 90 (backend max). Also test the same on an extension request.

title: Approve a checkout and pick an allocator
steps: Open Manage → Checkouts, filter 'Pending Approval'.
Click Approve on a request.
Pick an allocator (a suggested one may be pre-selected) and confirm.
expected: Status moves to approved/awaiting handover; the requester gets a notification; the list refreshes.

title: BUG CHECK — rejection reports success even if it failed
precondition: Manager; a pending checkout; dev tools handy
steps: Click Reject on a pending checkout, type a reason, confirm.
Now repeat with the network offline (or the API blocked) and watch the toast.
expected: CURRENT BUG: the toast says 'Checkout rejected.' even when the server call failed, and the modal closes. Verify and log — this is a high-priority fix.

title: Allocate with a handover photo
steps: On the approved order click 'Hand Over' (or Hand Over All).
Take/upload the handover photo when asked.
Confirm.
expected: Handover completes; requester is asked to confirm receipt; photo is stored on the checkout.

title: Employee confirms receipt, then returns
precondition: You have an item pending receipt
steps: My Items → Active: click 'Confirm Receipt & Upload Photo', add a photo, confirm.
Later, click 'Return Item', add the return photo, submit.
expected: Receipt moves the item to 'allocated' with a days-left bar. Return completes with a photo and drops off Active into Past.

title: Ask for more time and have it approved
steps: My Items → the item → 'Extend Item'. Pick extra days (≤90), give a reason, submit.
As the manager, approve the extension inline in Checkouts.
expected: Due date extends after approval; both sides get notifications.

title: BUG CHECK — batch days above 90 fail silently
steps: My Items → Past: tick 2-3 items → 'Request Again (N)'.
Set one item's days to 100 (the box currently allows up to 365).
Submit and read the result toast carefully.
expected: CURRENT BUG: the backend rejects >90 days so that item silently fails inside the batch. Log which items succeeded vs failed.

title: Assign an item to a person — the list must be Nexus People
steps: Manage → find a permanent item → Assign.
Open the person dropdown and read the list.
expected: The dropdown lists curated Nexus People (short list, real names) — NOT the ~150-account M365 directory. People without a work email or offboarded must not appear.

title: Accept with photo / decline
precondition: An assignment is pending your acceptance
steps: My Items → Permanent: click 'Accept & Upload Photo', add photo, accept.
On another test assignment click Decline.
expected: Accept requires the photo and activates the assignment. BUG CHECK: Decline currently uses the browser's ugly prompt() for the reason — log it.

title: Report lost / dead and return flows
precondition: You hold an active permanent item
steps: Click 'Report Lost' on your item and follow the flow (no photo needed for lost).
As the manager, open the Assignments queue and accept the return with a disposition.
expected: Lost/dead flows start a return with the right flag; the manager's Accept Return closes it and updates the item status.

title: Add, edit and delete an item
steps: Manage → 'Add Item': fill name/type, save.
Edit the same item: change one field, save.
Delete it: the dialog asks you to literally type DELETE.
expected: Add/edit reflect immediately; serial (GG-#####) is auto-assigned and cannot be edited. Delete is soft — the item moves to the Recycle Bin for 30 days.

title: Curated item types list
steps: Manage → 'Manage Types'.
Add a type (e.g. 'QA Widget').
Try deleting a type that's in use, then one with 0 items, then try to delete 'Other'.
expected: Add works. In-use delete asks an inline confirm; zero-count delete is IMMEDIATE (bug — log it); 'Other' cannot be removed.

title: CSV import preview matches what actually happens
precondition: Manager; a small CSV of items incl. a custom type you created
steps: Manage → Import: choose your CSV.
Read the preview counts (valid / skipped / unknown type).
Import and compare the result toast to the preview.
expected: BUG CHECK: the preview may claim your manager-added custom type is 'unknown → saved as Other' even though the import actually keeps it. Log any mismatch between preview and result.

title: Batch photos + AI photo fill
steps: Manage → select several items → Batch Photos.
Try a master image applied to all, then AI Fill for the rest.
expected: Photos apply with progress; AI fill only fills blanks (doesn't replace). NOTE: items flagged 'no photo required' (e.g. keys) should NOT be counted in the red 'missing photo' banner — currently they are; log it.

title: Restore a deleted item
steps: Manage → Recycle Bin.
Check the 'purges in N d' badge.
Restore the item.
expected: Item returns to the list unchanged.

title: By person and by location
steps: Open 'Who Has What'.
Switch between By Person and By Location.
Click an item to open its mini-card and deep-link.
expected: Both views group correctly with $ totals; deep links land on the right queue. NOTE: while data is loading it may flash 'No items are currently allocated' — log if you see the false empty state.

title: Fulfil a purchase request into Items
steps: Purchase Requests tab: Approve one (pick the fulfiller).
Mark Ordered.
Click 'Received — Add to Items' and complete the pre-filled Add Item form.
expected: Each step advances the status; the final step creates the item AND closes the requisition. BUG CHECK: rejecting a requisition currently shows NO toast — log it.

title: Plain-English feed + undo
steps: Open Activity Log.
Read a few entries — they should be sentences, with old → new for edits.
Find an edit or delete you made and click Undo, confirm inline.
expected: Undo reverses the change (restores the item/fields) and the feed records the reversal.

title: Bulk overdue alert
steps: Checkouts tab → the overdue badge/section → 'Overdue Alert'.
Untick one person, keep the rest.
Send.
expected: One email + bell per selected person (not per item). The unticked person gets nothing.

title: Portfolio loads with tiles, list and map views
steps: Open Asset Management from the sidebar.
Wait for the cards to appear.
Use the view toggle to switch Tiles → List → Map and back.
expected: Cards render in a 4-up grid; List shows sortable columns; Map shows pins. The asset count in the header matches.

title: Search and filters
steps: Type part of an asset name in the search box.
Set Category/Stage/Type/Region filters.
Click 'Clear Filters'.
expected: Grid narrows; a 'no properties match' message shows when nothing fits; Clear restores everything. NOTE: dropdown counts ignore other active filters — that is currently by design; log only if confusing.

title: List column widths are draggable and remembered
steps: In List view, drag a column edge to resize it.
Reload the page and return to List view.
expected: Your column widths survive the reload (saved locally).

title: Add a property via the 2-step wizard
steps: Open Manage → Add Asset.
Step 1: choose 'Property'.
Step 2: fill the required fields (marked), add a photo, Save.
Also try saving with a required field empty.
expected: Missing required fields are called out (currently via a browser alert — log as UX inconsistency). On save the new property appears in the portfolio.

title: Add a vehicle and heavy equipment
steps: Add Asset → choose 'Vehicle', fill fields, save.
Repeat with 'Heavy Equipment'.
expected: Each class gets its own field set; the detail page later shows vehicle-specific tabs (service, odometer, vdocs).

title: CSV bulk import per class
steps: Add Asset → Step 1 → download the CSV template for Property.
Fill 2 rows (one missing the name).
Import the file.
expected: The named row imports; the row without a name is skipped and reported. Result is currently shown in a browser alert — log as inconsistency.

title: Edit the spec sheet; address changes need a reason
steps: Open a property → Edit.
Change a normal field and save (should just save).
Edit again and change the ADDRESS.
Try to save.
expected: Changing address/city/state/zip demands a typed reason before saving, and the change lands in the activity log with that reason.

title: Flag a field for review and fix it from Manage
steps: On the spec sheet, click the little flag next to a field and give a reason.
Go to Manage → 'Flagged for Review'.
Find your flag, check the 'current value' box, type a fix and push it.
expected: Flag appears with your reason. BUG CHECK: for top-level fields (address, manager…) the 'current value' box may show BLANK even though the asset has a value — pushing from blank can wipe it. Log carefully.

title: Link parcels into a group
steps: Open a property → Parcel Manager.
Link the second property under it as Secondary.
Reorder with the arrows; try the star to change Primary; rename the group.
expected: Group card on the portfolio aggregates stats; the 'Go to' switcher hops between members; unlink restores them as standalone.

title: Add a maintenance record with a unit selector
steps: Open the property → Maintenance tab → quick-add bar or Add.
Note the 'Unit / Suite' dropdown in the form.
Save the record.
expected: Record appears in the sortable table; the summary strip updates; unit dropdown only appears for properties that have units.

title: Deleting a warranty needs a reason
precondition: A warranty record exists; manager grant
steps: Warranties tab → edit a record → Delete.
Try deleting without typing a reason.
expected: Warranty delete demands a typed reason (all other record types delete with just a confirm).

title: Timeline status change requires a reason
precondition: A property with a timeline entry
steps: Timeline tab → click the status of an entry → pick a new status.
Try to confirm without a reason.
expected: Status change is blocked until a reason is typed; it then appears in the activity log.

title: Exports handle blocked pop-ups
steps: Block pop-ups for the site in your browser.
Try Export → PDF from the breadcrumb, and a table's CSV/PDF export.
expected: BUG CHECK: with pop-ups blocked, nothing happens and no message appears. Log it (needs an 'allow pop-ups' toast).

title: Completeness, activity log undo, trash
steps: Open Manage: read the KPI tiles.
Data Completeness: check % bars + missing-field chips.
Activity Log: find an edit → Undo (inline confirm).
Trash: delete a test asset first, then Recover it; then Purge another test asset.
expected: Undo restores the previous value. Recover brings the asset back; Purge asks an inline 'cannot be undone' confirm and removes it permanently.

title: Mark an asset Private
precondition: Two accounts: one owner/exec, one normal
steps: As owner: open an asset → 'Mark Private' in the breadcrumb.
As a normal user: search for that asset.
expected: Private assets are invisible to non-privileged users everywhere (portfolio, search, critical dates).

title: Critical dates banner and bell notifications
precondition: An asset with a warranty/registration expiring soon
steps: Set a test warranty to expire in ~2 weeks.
Reopen Asset Management (triggers the reminder scan).
Check the Critical Items banner and the bell.
expected: The item appears in the banner window (≤30/≤90) and one bell notification exists for it (not duplicated on every visit).

title: BUG CHECK — edits during sync conflicts
precondition: Two browser tabs on the same asset
steps: Open the same asset in two tabs.
Edit field A in tab 1 and save; within a few seconds edit field B in tab 2 and save.
Wait ~10 s and check both fields in both tabs.
expected: CURRENT RISK: last writer wins per the sync rule; one edit may silently vanish with only the 'Saved' pill showing. Log exactly what survived — this is a known high-priority UX gap.

title: BUG CHECK — clicking outside a form loses your typing
precondition: Add Asset wizard open with data typed
steps: Type several fields into the Add Asset form.
Click once on the dark area OUTSIDE the modal.
expected: CURRENT BUG: the modal closes instantly and everything typed is lost (no 'discard?' guard). Log it.

title: Create a template in the WYSIWYG editor
steps: Open Documents → Templates → New.
Type a paragraph; insert a merge chip (e.g. employee name) from the merge menu.
Add a signature block and assign it to signer role 1.
Add a second signer role. Save.
expected: The paper preview matches what a signer will see; merge chips render as labelled pills; the template appears in the list.

title: Attach a PDF/Word and place fields
precondition: A template open in the editor
steps: Attach a PDF (and separately a .docx — it should convert to PDF in the browser).
In the placer, drag a signature field onto page 1 for signer 1.
Save the template.
expected: Both attach; docx converts client-side; fields stick to the page where you dropped them.

title: BUG CHECK — duplicate loses the Egnyte folder
precondition: A template with an Egnyte folder set
steps: Click Duplicate on that template.
Open the copy and check its Egnyte folder setting.
expected: CURRENT BUG: the duplicate's Egnyte folder is empty (not copied). Log it.

title: CAUTION — delete has no confirmation
steps: Hover the trash icon on a test template.
Click it ONCE.
expected: CURRENT BUG: the template is deleted immediately — no 'are you sure', no undo. Verify on a throwaway only and log.

title: BUG CHECK — clicking outside the editor loses all edits
precondition: Template editor open with unsaved changes
steps: Make several edits in the template editor.
Click the dark backdrop outside the editor once.
expected: CURRENT BUG: editor closes and the edits are gone, no guard. Log it.

title: Send a template for signature (sequential)
steps: Click Send → pick the template → choose the 'About' person/company.
Recipients: add a teammate (autocomplete) as signer 1 and an external email as signer 2; keep routing 'sequential'.
Preview: fill any merge inputs; watch amber highlights for unresolved ones.
Review & send.
expected: Envelope sends; signer 1 gets it first, signer 2 only after 1 signs. NOTE: sending with unresolved merge tokens is currently NOT blocked — if you leave one amber, the final PDF will literally contain {{token}}. Log if you can send with gaps.

title: External signer with an access code
steps: Add an external recipient and set an access code.
Send, then open the signing link (copy it from the request detail).
Enter a WRONG code 3+ times, then the right one.
expected: Wrong codes are rejected and audited; too many attempts locks the link; the right code opens the document.

title: BUG CHECK — bad emails and past expiry are accepted
steps: Type 'a@' as a recipient email — does the wizard let you continue?
Set the expiry date to YESTERDAY and send.
expected: CURRENT BUGS: '@' anywhere passes validation, and a past expiry sends an already-dead envelope. Log both.

title: Sign as a teammate (guided)
steps: Open the document from your Inbox.
Click START — it jumps to your first field.
Adopt a signature (try Type, then Draw with undo).
Complete all fields and Finish.
expected: Progress bar tracks your fields; Finish only enables when required fields are done; you get the sealed copy when everyone has signed.

title: Decline with a reason
steps: Open the document → Decline.
Type a reason (also try leaving it empty) and confirm.
expected: Decline ends the envelope and notifies the sender. NOTE: an EMPTY reason is currently allowed — log it.

title: Remind, void, and correct a party
steps: Open the request detail: click Remind.
Use 'correct party' to fix a signer's email.
On a THROWAWAY envelope click Void.
expected: Remind re-notifies the current signer. Correcting an email rotates the link + resends. CAUTION/BUG: Void fires with NO confirmation — verify on a throwaway and log.

title: Sealed PDF + verify
steps: Open the completed request → download the sealed PDF.
Click 'Verify integrity'.
expected: PDF downloads with the certificate page; verify reports the SHA-256 matches. (A tampered file must report invalid.)

title: Edit text mode and redaction warning
precondition: A PDF attached to a template
steps: Open the PDF in the editor → Edit text → change a line → save.
Draw a black 'Redact' box over some text and save.
Open the saved PDF and try to SELECT the text under the black box.
expected: Edited line re-renders (font may differ slightly). CAUTION/BUG: the black box is visual only — the text underneath is still selectable/extractable. Never rely on it for SSNs/salaries. Log.

title: BUG CHECK — sender shown as a raw email
precondition: You have items in your Documents inbox
steps: Open the Documents inbox and read the 'from …' line on an item.
expected: CURRENT BUG: shows the sender's raw email instead of their name. Log it (house rule: names, never raw emails).

title: Punch in with the BOD gate and location chip
precondition: Employee; on/near a work site if possible
steps: Open Time Clock → Clock tab.
Click 'Punch in' — the start-of-day message box opens.
Type a short update (or tick 'already sent') and continue.
Read the small location chip next to the punch.
expected: Punch lands with a toast showing the time + site. Chip reads 'at site' (green) / 'Xm from site — flagged' (amber) / 'approx ±Xm' / 'no location'. Punching out asks for the end-of-day message the same way.

title: Location denied is soft — never blocks
precondition: Browser location permission DENIED for the site
steps: Deny location for the site in browser settings.
Punch in.
expected: The punch still succeeds with a 'no location' chip. BUG CHECK: you get no hint that location was BLOCKED vs simply unavailable — log the missing guidance.

title: Breaks track and warn when over
steps: Click 'Start break' (answer the gate).
Wait past the allowance (or check with a long test break).
End the break.
expected: Break time shows in Today; a red 'Break over by N min' warning appears when past the allowance.

title: Manual and flagged punches are marked
precondition: Some punches incl. a manager-adjusted one
steps: Open the Timesheet tab, set range 14 days.
Expand a day and look at the punch chips.
expected: Manager-adjusted punches show dashed with a ⓜ; out-of-fence ones are amber with ⚠; the legend explains both. (Manager screens use a plain 'M' for the same thing — log the inconsistency.)

title: Missed-punch self-correction has a 7-day window
steps: Use 'Missed a punch?' to submit a correction for 2 days ago.
Then try one for 10 days ago.
expected: Recent correction is accepted (flagged for manager review); the 10-day-old one is rejected by the server with a clear message.

title: Request time off; check the year view
steps: Request 2 days of vacation next week with a note.
Look at 'Year at a glance'.
expected: Request shows Pending; year view counts approved days by type. GAPS to log: no balance/entitlement shown anywhere, and end-before-start dates are accepted.

title: Approve timecards day-by-day and week
steps: Open the Time admin area → Timecards.
Expand a person → approve one day, then 'Approve week'.
Adjust one punch afterwards and re-check the approval.
expected: Approvals stick; after editing a punch the day shows as needing RE-approval (stale detection).

title: BUG CHECK — cancelling the reject prompt still rejects
steps: Click Reject on a pending time-off request.
When the browser prompt asks for a note, click CANCEL.
expected: CURRENT BUG (high): the request is rejected anyway with an empty reason. Expected: cancel should abort. Verify and log.

title: Punch adjust keeps the original visible
steps: Edit a punch time via the pencil.
Save and re-open the day.
expected: The corrected punch shows as manual/adjusted and the original value is preserved (frozen) in the record.

title: Payroll timecard totals and OT
steps: Open Payroll → pick an employee and a biweekly period.
Check the weekly split: regular vs overtime (1.5x over 40 h/week).
Set a rate and check the wage totals.
Click Approve and export CSV.
expected: OT math is right per week. BUG CHECKS: (a) Approve may not stick / not show any approved state — verify against the Timecards tab; (b) CSV click gives no feedback if it fails; (c) with no employees the tab can spin forever. Log all.

title: Build a weekly schedule
precondition: Manager; a shift group with members
steps: Create a shift preset (code, times, colour) and a group.
In the weekly grid click an empty cell to place a shift; click again to edit/remove.
Check the day/week hour totals and any 'Requested off' cells.
expected: Shifts place/edit/remove; totals update. CAUTION/BUG: deleting a preset/group fires with no confirm — test on throwaways and log. Also note the grid is mouse-only (no keyboard) and scrolls sideways on phones.

title: Desktop agent enroll and revoke
steps: Open the desktop-agent admin: download the installer, enroll a device.
See the device in the table.
Click Revoke.
expected: Device shows enrolled; screenshots surface on the person's day view. CAUTION/BUG: Revoke cuts the device instantly with NO confirm — log it.

title: Time format consistency (log all findings)
steps: Note the time format (12h vs 24h) on: the Clock tab, the Timesheet, Payroll, and the Shifts grid.
expected: BUG CHECK: today these differ (locale-based on some screens, forced 12h on others). Log each screen's format so we can unify.

title: Default dashboard loads for a new user
precondition: A user with no saved views
steps: Open Dashboard.
Count the starter widgets (clock, quick actions, KPI tiles, notifications, links).
expected: The default layout renders without gaps or overlaps; every widget shows data or a sensible empty state.

title: Add a KPI widget with the metric picker
steps: Click 'Add widget'.
Pick a KPI tile → choose a metric from the picker (e.g. Open tasks).
Add it.
expected: The gallery is grouped by category; the new tile lands at the bottom and shows the chosen metric. NOTE: adding with no metric picked currently creates a blank 'Metric / 0' tile — log if you manage it.

title: Drag, resize, remove — watch for overlaps
steps: Click Customize.
Drag a widget by its header onto another widget's position.
Resize one from its corner handle over a neighbour.
Click Auto-fit afterwards.
expected: BUG CHECK: drops/resizes can currently OVERLAP other widgets until you press Auto-fit. Log whether overlap happens. Remove (✕) should delete instantly.

title: Save, rename, switch, delete views
steps: Customize → change something → Save (name it 'QA test').
Switch to 'Default layout' then back via the view dropdown.
Rename the view, set it as default, then delete it.
expected: Each action works and survives a reload; delete asks for confirmation; the unsaved-changes guard prompts when switching away from a dirty layout.

title: Publish a department view (manager)
steps: Build a layout → Save → publish it to your department.
Sign in as a teammate in that department and open their view dropdown.
expected: The department view appears for teammates under 'Department views'; only the publisher can update/delete it.

title: Manager Dashboard gating and team numbers
precondition: One supervisor+ account, one plain employee
steps: As an employee, try to open Manager Dashboard.
As a supervisor/manager, open it and read the team KPIs (approvals, attendance).
expected: The employee gets an access message. The manager sees team-scoped tiles and panels.

title: BUG CHECK — 'Unread notifications' counts everything
precondition: A user with read + unread notifications
steps: Add the 'Unread notifications' KPI tile.
Read all your notifications via the bell.
Watch the tile.
expected: CURRENT BUG: the number does not drop — it counts ALL notifications, not unread. Log it.

title: BUG CHECK — sample data shown as live
steps: Add the Facilities/Occupancy panel and the Team analytics panels.
Compare the numbers to reality.
expected: CURRENT BUG (trust): these panels show hardcoded sample data ('Live occupancy…') that never changes. Log which panels are fake so they can be wired or badged 'Sample'.

title: Widgets after an approval — stale numbers
precondition: A pending requisition + the matching KPI tile
steps: Note the 'to approve' count on the tile.
Approve the requisition from the approvals panel.
Watch the tile (without reloading).
expected: BUG CHECK: the tile currently stays stale until a full page reload. Log it.

title: BUG CHECK — notes typed outside edit mode can be lost
precondition: A Notes widget on the dashboard
steps: WITHOUT entering Customize, click into the Notes widget and type something.
Click elsewhere (blur), then navigate to another module and come back.
expected: CURRENT BUG: the note may be gone — typing in view mode marks changes but there is no Save outside edit mode. Log what happens.

title: Phone behaviour is honest
steps: Open Dashboard on a phone.
Try Customize → try to drag or resize.
expected: Widgets stack in one column. BUG CHECK: Customize still shows drag/resize handles that silently do nothing on mobile — log it.
